BLS12381.g2Add.counterpart_caveat: Native uses validated 256-byte EIP-2537 uncompressed point inputs and emits compressed bytes; plugin accepts 96-byte compressed inputs and also recovers missing coordinates.

BLS12381.g2Mul.counterpart_caveat: Native starts from trusted predecoded points/scalars and encodes the mathematical result outside timing; plugin includes packed compressed decoding, scalar/subgroup validation and output encoding.

BLS12381.g2Msm.counterpart_caveat: Native starts from trusted predecoded points/scalars and encodes the mathematical result outside timing; plugin includes packed compressed decoding, scalar/subgroup validation and output encoding.

BLS12381.pairingCheck.counterpart_caveat: Native starts from trusted predecoded points; plugin validates every packed compressed point and subgroup before pairing.
